```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, 
  warning = FALSE, 
  message = FALSE,
  results = 'hide'
)

# Set working directory to project root
setwd("~/Documents/Github/HLA-I_Analysis/directory")

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(scales)
library(writexl)  # For Excel output
library(kableExtra)  # For enhanced tables
library(openxlsx)  # For advanced Excel functionality
library(UpSetR)  # For UpSet plots
library(VennDiagram)  # For Venn diagrams (if needed)
library(RColorBrewer)  # For color palettes
library(ggdendro)  # For dendrogram plots

# Source all function files
source("functions/core/immunopeptidomics_core_functions.R")
source("functions/validation/immunopeptidomics_validation_functions.R") 
source("functions/plotting/immunopeptidomics_plotting_functions.R")
source("functions/utils/immunopeptidomics_utils_functions.R")
source("functions/analysis/immunopeptidomics_intensity_analysis_functions.R")
source("functions/analysis/immunopeptidomics_fusion_search_functions.R")
source("functions/analysis/immunopeptidomics_peptide_sharing_functions.R")
source("functions/analysis/fix_transcriptome.R")
source("functions/analysis/immunopeptidomics_ru148_analysis_functions.R")
source("functions/analysis/multiomic_shared_neoantigen.R")
source("functions/analysis/immunopeptidomics_gtex_analysis_functions.R")

# Analysis parameters
analysis_params <- list(
  dataset_name = params$dataset_name,
  data_directory = params$data_directory,
  filter_modified = params$filter_modified,
  exclude_samples = params$exclude_samples,
  include_samples = params$include_samples,
  analysis_type = "streamlined_png_csv",
  timestamp = format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"),
  # Intensity analysis parameters
  run_intensity_analysis = params$run_intensity_analysis,
  intensity_analysis_data_source = params$intensity_analysis_data_source,
  intensity_analysis_file = params$intensity_analysis_file,
  intensity_analysis_folder = params$intensity_analysis_folder,
  intensity_exclude_samples = params$intensity_exclude_samples,
  intensity_include_samples = params$intensity_include_samples,
  # Fusion search parameters
  run_fusion_search = params$run_fusion_search,
  fusion_search_data_source = params$fusion_search_data_source,
  fusion_search_file = params$fusion_search_file,
  # Peptide sharing parameters
  run_peptide_sharing = params$run_peptide_sharing,
  peptide_sharing_min_length = params$peptide_sharing_min_length,
  peptide_sharing_max_length = params$peptide_sharing_max_length,
  peptide_sharing_exclude_samples = params$peptide_sharing_exclude_samples,
  peptide_sharing_include_samples = params$peptide_sharing_include_samples
)

# Create output directory structure (plots/ and tables/ with analysis subdirectories)
output_dir <- create_output_directory_enhanced(
  base_dir = getwd(),
  dataset_name = analysis_params$dataset_name,
  analysis_type = analysis_params$analysis_type
)

cat("=== IMMUNOPEPTIDOMICS ANALYSIS STARTED ===\n")
cat("Dataset:", analysis_params$dataset_name, "\n")
cat("Output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
cat("Timestamp:", analysis_params$timestamp, "\n")
cat("Intensity analysis enabled:", analysis_params$run_intensity_analysis, "\n")
cat("Fusion search enabled:", analysis_params$run_fusion_search, "\n")
cat("Peptide sharing enabled:", analysis_params$run_peptide_sharing, "\n\n")
```

```{r validate_and_load}
cat("STEP 1: Validating input and loading data...\n")

# Validate input directory
validation_results <- validate_input_directory(analysis_params$data_directory)
if (!validation_results$valid) {
  stop("Input validation failed: ", paste(validation_results$errors, collapse = "; "))
}

# Get file lists and load raw data
file_lists <- list_tsv_files(analysis_params$data_directory)
data_2cv_raw <- read_peptide_files(file_lists$files_2cv, "2cv")
data_3cv_raw <- read_peptide_files(file_lists$files_3cv, "3cv")

cat("✓ Loaded", ifelse(is.null(data_2cv_raw), 0, nrow(data_2cv_raw)), "2CV entries\n")
cat("✓ Loaded", ifelse(is.null(data_3cv_raw), 0, nrow(data_3cv_raw)), "3CV entries\n\n")
```

```{r before_analysis}
cat("STEP 2: Analyzing raw data (before combination)...\n")

# Analyze raw data before combination
raw_analysis <- analyze_raw_data(data_2cv_raw, data_3cv_raw)
sample_analysis_before <- analyze_samples_before_combination(data_2cv_raw, data_3cv_raw)

cat("✓ Before-combination analysis completed\n\n")
```

```{r data_combination}
cat("STEP 3: Combining 2CV and 3CV data...\n")

# Perform enhanced data combination
combined_data <- combine_peptide_data_enhanced(
  analysis_params$data_directory, 
  filter_modified = analysis_params$filter_modified
)

cat("✓ Data combination completed:", nrow(combined_data), "unique peptides\n\n")
```

```{r validation}
cat("STEP 4: Validating combination results...\n")

# Validate the combination process
combination_validation <- validate_combination(combined_data, raw_analysis)
intensity_comparison <- compare_intensity_distributions(data_2cv_raw, data_3cv_raw, combined_data)
validation_report <- generate_validation_report(raw_analysis, combination_validation, intensity_comparison)

cat("✓ Post-combination validation completed\n\n")
```

```{r correlation_analysis}
cat("STEP 5: Performing correlation analysis with progress tracking...\n")

# Prepare data and perform correlation analysis WITH PROGRESS TRACKING
correlation_data <- prepare_correlation_data(combined_data)

# Use the enhanced function with progress indicators
correlation_results <- perform_correlation_analysis_with_progress(
  correlation_data$data_2cv, 
  correlation_data$data_3cv
)

cat("✓ Correlation analysis completed\n\n")
```

```{r statistical_analysis}
cat("STEP 6: Generating statistical summaries...\n")

# Calculate comprehensive statistics
nonzero_data <- combined_data %>% filter(!is.na(final_intensity) & final_intensity > 0)

final_intensity_stats <- calculate_statistics(combined_data$final_intensity, "Final_Intensity_All")
nonzero_intensity_stats <- calculate_statistics(nonzero_data$final_intensity, "Final_Intensity_NonZero") 
log_intensity_stats <- calculate_statistics(log10(nonzero_data$final_intensity), "Log10_Final_Intensity")

comprehensive_statistics <- rbind(final_intensity_stats, nonzero_intensity_stats, log_intensity_stats)

# Calculate percentiles
percentiles <- quantile(nonzero_data$final_intensity, 
                       probs = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99), 
                       na.rm = TRUE)
intensity_percentiles <- data.frame(
  Percentile = names(percentiles),
  Value = as.numeric(percentiles)
)

cat("✓ Statistical analysis completed\n\n")
```

```{r create_plots}
cat("STEP 7: Creating all plots...\n")

# Create all plot objects
all_plots <- list()

# Before/after comparison plots
all_plots$before_after <- create_before_after_intensity_plots(
  data_2cv_raw, data_3cv_raw, combined_data, file.path(output_dir, "plots")
)

# Peptide overlap plot
all_plots$overlap <- create_peptide_overlap_plot(
  data_2cv_raw, data_3cv_raw, file.path(output_dir, "plots")
)

# Correlation plots
all_plots$correlation <- create_correlation_plots(
  correlation_results, file.path(output_dir, "plots")
)

# Statistical summary plots
all_plots$statistical <- create_statistical_summary_plots(
  combined_data, file.path(output_dir, "plots")
)

cat("✓ All plot objects created\n\n")
```

```{r save_all_outputs}
cat("STEP 8: Saving all PNG plots and CSV tables...\n")

# Compile all results for saving
all_results <- list(
  raw_analysis = raw_analysis,
  sample_analysis_before = sample_analysis_before,
  combination_validation = combination_validation,
  intensity_comparison = intensity_comparison,
  validation_report = validation_report,
  correlation_results = correlation_results,
  comprehensive_statistics = comprehensive_statistics,
  intensity_percentiles = intensity_percentiles,
  combined_data = combined_data
)

# Save all plots as numbered PNG files with improved naming
saved_plots <- save_all_plots_as_png_improved(all_plots, output_dir, analysis_params$dataset_name, analysis_params$timestamp)

# Save all tables as numbered CSV files with improved naming
saved_tables <- save_all_tables_as_csv_improved(all_results, output_dir, analysis_params$dataset_name, analysis_params$timestamp)

cat("\n=== MAIN ANALYSIS COMPLETED ===\n")
cat("Core PNG files saved:", length(saved_plots), "\n")
cat("Core CSV files saved:", length(saved_tables), "\n")
cat("Output directory:", output_dir, "\n")
```

```{r intensity_analysis, eval=analysis_params$run_intensity_analysis}
cat("STEP 9: Performing intensity analysis...\n")

if (analysis_params$run_intensity_analysis) {
  
  # Prepare intensity analysis data
  intensity_data <- prepare_intensity_data(
    data_source = analysis_params$intensity_analysis_data_source,
    combined_data = combined_data,
    file_path = analysis_params$intensity_analysis_file,
    folder_path = analysis_params$intensity_analysis_folder,
    exclude_samples = analysis_params$intensity_exclude_samples,
    include_samples = analysis_params$intensity_include_samples
  )
  
  # Perform comprehensive intensity analysis
  intensity_results <- perform_intensity_analysis(
    data = intensity_data,
    output_dir = output_dir,
    dataset_name = analysis_params$dataset_name,
    timestamp = analysis_params$timestamp
  )
  
  # Create intensity analysis visualizations
  intensity_plots <- create_intensity_analysis_plots(
    analysis_results = intensity_results,
    dataset_name = analysis_params$dataset_name,
    timestamp = analysis_params$timestamp
  )
  
  cat("✓ Intensity analysis completed\n")
  cat("  - Sample breakdown analysis\n")
  cat("  - Missing/zero value analysis\n")
  cat("  - Comprehensive statistical analysis\n")
  cat("  - Percentiles and thresholds\n")
  cat("  - Spectral count correlation analysis\n")
  cat("  - Individual and combined visualizations\n")
  cat("  - Files saved in:", file.path(basename(output_dir), "intensity_analysis"), "\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("Intensity analysis skipped (disabled in parameters)\n\n")
}
```

```{r fusion_search, eval=analysis_params$run_fusion_search}
cat("STEP 10: Performing DNAJB1-PRKACA fusion peptide search...\n")

if (analysis_params$run_fusion_search) {
  
  # Prepare fusion search data
  fusion_data <- prepare_fusion_search_data(
    data_source = analysis_params$fusion_search_data_source,
    combined_data = combined_data,
    file_path = analysis_params$fusion_search_file
  )
  
  # Perform fusion peptide search
  fusion_results <- perform_fusion_search(
    data = fusion_data,
    output_dir = output_dir,
    dataset_name = analysis_params$dataset_name,
    timestamp = analysis_params$timestamp,
    intensity_percentiles = intensity_percentiles
  )

  # Create fusion search visualizations (only if peptides found)
  fusion_plots <- create_fusion_search_plots(
    search_results = fusion_results,
    dataset_name = analysis_params$dataset_name,
    timestamp = analysis_params$timestamp
  )
  
  cat("✓ Fusion peptide search completed\n")
  cat("  - DNAJB1-PRKACA fusion sequence:", FUSION_SEQUENCE, "\n")
  cat("  - Junction position:", JUNCTION_POSITION, "\n")
  cat("  - Theoretical spanning peptides generated\n")
  cat("  - Search performed against dataset\n")
  cat("  - Results and visualizations created\n")
  cat("  - Files saved in:", file.path(basename(output_dir), "fusion_search"), "\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("Fusion peptide search skipped (disabled in parameters)\n\n")
}
```

```{r multiomic_shared_neoantigen}
cat("STEP 14: Performing Multiomic shared neoantigen analysis...\n")

# Fix namespace conflicts
library(dplyr)
select <- dplyr::select
filter <- dplyr::filter
mutate <- dplyr::mutate

# Call the function with corrected parameters
results <- analyze_neoantigens(
  combined_data = combined_data,
  min_samples_threshold = 6,
  samples_to_exclude = c("51S"),
  negative_control_samples = c("148N"),
  peptide_length_min = 8,
  peptide_length_max = 12,
  log2fc_up_threshold = 1,
  log2fc_down_threshold = -1,
  data_directory = "data",  # Changed from "directory/data" to "data"
  output_dir = file.path(output_dir, "neoantigen_analysis")  # Put results in subdirectory
)

# Access the results
integrated_peptides <- results$integrated_data
summary_statistics <- results$summary_stats

cat("✓ Multi-omics neoantigen analysis completed\n")
cat("  - Total peptides analyzed:", nrow(integrated_peptides), "\n")
cat("  - Data availability:\n")
cat("    - Transcriptome:", ifelse(results$data_availability$transcriptome, "✓", "✗"), "\n")
cat("    - LFQ Proteome:", ifelse(results$data_availability$lfq, "✓", "✗"), "\n")
cat("    - TMT Proteome:", ifelse(results$data_availability$tmt, "✓", "✗"), "\n")
cat("  - Results saved to:", basename(results$output_dir), "\n\n")
# Access the results
integrated_peptides <- results$integrated_data
summary_statistics <- results$summary_stats
```

```{r gtex_analysis}
    timestamp = analysis_params$timestamp,
    gtex_data_path = gtex_data_path,
    gtex_tpm_thresholds = gtex_tpm_thresholds,
    exclude_immune_privileged = exclude_immune_privileged,
    exclude_high_turnover = exclude_high_turnover,
    include_all_tissues = include_all_tissues,
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  cat("✓ GTEx analysis completed successfully!\n")
  cat("  - Input files processed:", length(gtex_results$input_files_processed), "\n")
  cat("  - TPM thresholds tested:", length(gtex_tmp_thresholds), "\n")
  cat("  - Analysis results:", length(gtex_results$results), "\n")
  cat("  - Plots created:", sum(sapply(gtex_results$plots_created, length)), "\n")
  cat("  - Results saved in:", basename(gtex_output_dir), "\n\n")
  
}
```
